name: 3d-space-pong
description: 3D Space Pong that keeps receipts. Built with three.js + parallax.js.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @3d-space-pong/shared run build && pnpm -r --parallel --filter=@3d-space-pong/web --filter=@3d-space-pong/server run dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @3d-space-pong/shared run build && pnpm --filter @3d-space-pong/server run build && pnpm --filter @3d-space-pong/web run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @3d-space-pong/shared run build && pnpm -r run typecheck
